## Design

### 2026-10-05 – First, I made the schematic of the LED chaser. I tried to understand what a 555 timer does, capacitors and more components. Then I made the PCB. I wanted to make mine unique so instead of having a rec

**4h**

First, I made the schematic of the LED chaser. I tried to understand what a 555 timer does, capacitors and more components. Then I made the PCB. I wanted to make mine unique so instead of having a rectangular board, I made the board outline of Thor's hammer.

At the start, there were too many traces to route, so I didn't know how to route them. Then I came across the term "via." That is a method of putting a trace from one layer into another layer and that gives more space for the traces to flow, which allows you to make your board even bigger and place even more components.

### 2026-10-05 – I was having a really big issue with not being able to route the wires. I tried different options and patterns, but it did not work. Then I googled it and discovered Vias. I had to make a via from one

**3h**

I was having a really big issue with not being able to route the wires. I tried different options and patterns, but it did not work. Then I googled it and discovered Vias. I had to make a via from one layer to another. Another problem was that the .dxf file for the board outline was getting inserted as a Topsilkscreen layer or something like that. But I wanted it to come as Board Outline. What I should have done was to right click on the layer and then choose import.
